newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 20.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:

* Viacom Inc's Paramount Pictures and Creative Artists Agency are embroiled in a legal tangle over Nicolas Cage's commitment and availability for Paramount's "Snake Eyes" and for Warner Bros.' "Superman."
* Walt Disney Co's ABC is expected to announce on Tuesday the appointment of Preston Padden as president of the ABC television network.
* Universal and DreamWorks have purchased "Cowboys & Aliens," a double-genre pitch.
* News Corp Ltd's Fox network is set to release its fall lineup on Tuesday.
* A combination of baking hot weather in Europe and a dearth of new releases cooled box office receipts overseas last weekend.
* Movie production companies are rushing to get their previews ready to roll onto screens showing Universal's "Lost World," movie.
* Music industry veteran Glen Brunman has been named executive vice president of the newly created Sony Corp's Music Soundtrax.
